d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with blunt bangs falls over a youthful, adolescent face with narrow, sleepy lilac eyes. The slender build is dressed in a royal blue military-style outfit featuring a short pleated skirt, a matching cape with gold trim and tassels, a gold-detailed sash, and a blue shako hat topped with a voluminous black plume. Signature details include gold-plated fingerless gloves and a gold-embossed blue military cap.
